_doc: Analysis paths the harness SHIPS but that no topic in the 32-corpus ever exercises. Mahmood's law: a check that never fires looks clean. For each never-fired path we answer (i) does any served page DISPLAY its output, (ii) at what k and is it meaningful, (iii) if never run, does the page say so or silently render a reassuring non-result. (iii) is the dangerous one; here it does not occur.

never_exercised.iii_state: GUARDED — no trial stores person-time; recurrent-event effects are stored as effect+CI or suppressed; nothing rendered
GUARDED — no pooled body has a high-risk trial whose removal changes k; the sensitivity block renders low-only/full only
GUARDED — renders 'not assessable' with reason, never a false 'no publication bias'

not_implemented_at_all._doc: These are NOT among the 22 — the harness does not implement them, so there is no unbuilt-but-rendered path that could show a reassuring non-result. Confirmed live at k=2 (colchicine-recurrent) and k=16 (probiotics): the page states 'publication bias from the registry ghost census, NOT funnel-plot asymmetry (unreliable at our small k)'.

verdict: 3 of 22 implemented paths never fire; all 3 are GUARDED (declared non-computation, not a silent reassuring null). The high-k-only methods (funnel/Egger/subgroup/meta-reg/dose-response) are NOT implemented, so the (iii) danger cannot occur here. BUT: zero-new-classes on a corpus that never exercises these paths means we have stopped finding defects IN THE PART WE TEST — the high-k stress topics are needed precisely to load these untested paths.
